description: Every tikzcd diagram in the corpus, one per page. Written by tests/corpus/cd/extract.py.

texinputs: refs/corpus/rewritten/ic-gant/M3P5 Geometry of Curves and Surfaces

exclusions.what: tikzcd in macro bodies, and documents whose \begin{document} is not in the main file
exclusions.why: No literal diagram text to take out; they are compared as part of their whole document in the other sources. Counted by extract.py.
Only files the oracle read are searched, so a document that dies early contributes what it reached.
